verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party natural-language interface for operating n8n itself, such as a chat-based workflow builder or a command assistant. The 'Convert natural language into API calls' item is a use case users can build as a workflow, and the agent and MCP Server Trigger nodes are developer building blocks. Neither shows that the product itself is operated by natural-language commands, so none of it earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
